text:
Adverse event summary for period 2026-Q2 includes two reported quality measures: SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” and CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate.” Data are summarized as recorded in the source measure records.

For SEP-B1, the unit is percent. The numerator was 61, the denominator was 694, and exclusions were 39. The reported rate was 9.31. The event_dates recorded for this measure were 2026-02-27, 2026-03-03, 2026-04-25, 2026-09-24, and 2026-11-13. This record identifies compliance with the sepsis bundle within 3 hours as the measured process outcome for the period.

For CLABSI-01, the unit is per 1,000 line-days. The numerator was 107, the denominator was 1242, and exclusions were 66. The reported rate was 90.99. The event_dates recorded for this measure were 2026-01-11, 2026-04-01, 2026-08-22, 2026-10-02, and 2026-11-03. This record identifies central line-associated bloodstream infection rate as the measured adverse event outcome for the period.

Across the two records, the measures describe sepsis bundle compliance and central line-associated bloodstream infection reporting for 2026-Q2 using the units, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, and event_dates provided in the source records. No additional causal factors, severity levels, patient outcomes, locations, unit-level attribution, or corrective actions were included in the supplied structured data. Infection control dashboard literature was available in the provided reference list [F16].
